items.title: 美国6月非农就业仅增5.7万，大幅低于预期11万；失业率4.2%、劳参率跌至2021年3月以来最低
items.summary: 美国劳工统计局（BLS）7月3日公布，6月非农就业人口仅增57,000人，远低于市场预期110,000人，前两个月数据合计下修74,000。失业率降至4.2%，但主因劳动参与率下滑0.3ppt至61.5%（2021年3月以来最低）。休闲及接待业骤减61,000人，专业商业服务+36,000，医疗卫生+22,000。平均时薪同比+3.5%。
items.why: 非农数据重大miss抑制美联储7月加息预期，美债收益率大幅下行利好港股成长估值（腾讯、阿里等）；sell put策略隐含波动率短期可能下降，窗口改善；但叠加鹰派点阵图，需动态审视。

items.title: US July 3: Dow +1% on NFP miss; Nasdaq -0.8% drags tech; Nasdaq 100 -1.6% and Philly Semiconductor Index -5.4% extend two-week rout
items.summary: US equities split sharply on July 3 as weak June payrolls (57K vs 110K exp) triggered defensive rotation. Dow Jones gained 1%+; Nasdaq slid 0.8%; Nasdaq 100 fell 1.6% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbled 5.4%, extending its two-week losses to 12%. Outperformers: utilities, health care, consumer staples. Underperformers: technology, communication services. S&P 500 roughly flat.
items.why: 科技/半导体板块两周跌12%叠加防御轮动，港美持仓中英伟达、美光、小米承压；Nasdaq/Dow分化信号持续，sell put需拉大安全垫；非农miss短期是利多但不改鹰派基调。

items.title: 特斯拉Q2 2026实际交付48.01万辆，大幅超预期40.6万辆（+18%）；同比+25%为2023年以来首次年度增长
items.summary: 特斯拉（TSLA）7月2日发布Q2 2026交付报告：共交付480,126辆（Model 3/Y 467,762辆），大幅超出华尔街共识406,024辆，高盛预估420,000辆；同比增长25%，为2023年以来首次年度正增长。储能部署13.5 GWh（同比+41%）。Q2财报安排7月22日盘后发布。
items.why: 交付量超预期18%是TSLA近两年最大正向催化剂，有力反转上轮"被BYD碾压"叙事；股价可能财报前大幅反弹，已有sell put需检查行权价安全边际；7/22财报前可考虑布局covered call锁定潜在上涨。
items.source: 特斯拉投资者关系（官方）/ Electrek

items.title: 中国6月制造业PMI升至50.3%，三连扩张；高技术制造PMI 53.5%受AI出口拉动
items.summary: NBS 6月30日公布，中国官方制造业PMI 50.3%（环比+0.3ppt，超预期50.1%），连续三月扩张。高技术制造业PMI高达53.5%，AI芯片/电脑等出口旺盛。新订单51.2%回正，出口订单50.1%回正。但出厂价格首次跌入收缩区间（48.2%），内需仍偏弱。ING预计Q2 GDP同比增长约4.6%，接近政府目标下限（4.5%-5.0%）。
items.why: AI驱动的高技术出口支撑制造扩张是港股科技链正面信号；但出厂价格收缩+内需偏弱对消费类标的（海底捞、蜜雪冰城）的改善预期需保持审慎。

items.title: USTR Opens Rare China Tariff Relief Comment Window — Deadline July 10; 178 product exclusions extended to Nov 10
items.summary: Following the May 2026 US-China state visit, USTR opened a narrow comment period (deadline July 10) for companies to seek tariff relief on non-sensitive Chinese imports. USTR Ambassador Greer confirmed negotiations with China will follow on areas of mutual trade benefit. Separately, exclusions on 178 Chinese product categories were extended to November 10, 2026.
items.why: 关税减免磋商窗口对拼多多/Temu跨境业务是潜在利好，7月10日提交期后进入磋商期；同类小米、消费科技出口链亦有边际受益；需关注谈判结果与第三轮关税豁免公告。

items.title: 阿里巴巴FY2026股息：普通股每股US$0.13125（约US$1.05/ADS），7月6日（普通股）/ 7月13日（ADS）兑付
items.summary: 阿里巴巴集团（SEC 6-K披露）就FY2026宣派年度现金股息：每股普通股约US$0.13125，折合每ADS约US$1.05，将以美元发放。普通股支付日约为2026年7月6日，ADS持有人支付日约为2026年7月13日。股息在DOJ $6亿和解落地、股价RSI跌至25极度超卖背景下发放。
items.why: 分红即将落袋（7/6）叠加超卖技术面与DOJ悬案解除，BABA/9988.HK短期反弹概率上升；sell put注意7/6除权日影响，行权价应酌情下调以覆盖股息效应。
items.source: 阿里巴巴集团（SEC 6-K官方披露）

items.title: 美团Keeta携手哈利法基金推出"Programme ABAAD"，深度扎根阿联酋数字餐饮生态
items.summary: 2026年6月，Keeta（美团海外品牌）与哈利法基金在阿联酋联合发起"Programme ABAAD"，为本土餐饮中小企业提供数字化接入、培训及增长支持。Keeta已实现沙迦+迪拜+阿布扎比全覆盖，并于2月与阿布扎比ADDED签署数据共享MoU。Keeta Q1 2026亏损同比收窄约60%，沙特市场接近月度盈亏平衡。
items.why: 美团（3690.HK）Keeta中东扩张进入"嵌入式"阶段，有助于加速亏损收窄时间轴；配合Q1 Keeta财务改善，出海故事逻辑完整度提升，是中长期持仓的催化剂。

items.title: 老铺黄金(6181.HK)：预计7月8日派息、收益率5%；股价HK$496，机构目标价HK$1,010，折让超50%
items.summary: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）预计于2026年7月8日派发股息，当前股息收益率约5.0%。分析师共识将2026年收入预测从CNY 368亿上调至CNY 417亿，净利润增速预期约+66%。截至2026年3月，门店达50家（43内地+7海外）。当前股价HK$496较52周高位HK$1,108折让超50%；金价在约US$4,000/oz高位整理。
items.why: 派息日（7/8）临近提供短期股价锚点；金价高位+估值折让大意味着中长期上行空间可观；sell put行权价可参考52周低位约540港元布局。

items.title: 美股芯片股暴跌：Micron -8%、SanDisk -10%、Intel -9%、AMD -5%
items.summary: 美股周二科技股全线重挫，半导体板块领跌。美光（MU）大跌8%，闪迪（SNDK）跌逾10%，英特尔（INTC）下挫9%，AMD跌约5%，台积电ADR（TSM）跌6%。BofA泡沫风险指标达近年高位，市场忧虑AI资本开支降温、需求前景承压。
items.why: 持有MU/SNDK/INTC观察仓，半导体板块系统性重估；波动率急升影响sell put策略隐含波动率定价。

items.title: 韩国KOSPI重挫6.25%：三星-9%、SK海力士-14.57%领跌
items.summary: 7月2日亚市开盘，韩国KOSPI指数暴跌6.25%，三星电子大跌约9%，SK海力士（000660）单日跌14.57%，创近年最大单日跌幅。导火索为美股前夜半导体股全线崩跌以及AI资本开支前景不确定性。港股科技板块同步承压。
items.why: 持有SK海力士港股ETF（7709.HK / 南方两倍做多CSOP）；单日-14.57%触发风控关注，隐含波动率激增影响sell put策略。

items.title: Meta to offer excess AI compute as cloud service — Bloomberg
items.summary: Bloomberg reports Meta Platforms plans to rent out surplus AI computing capacity to enterprise customers, entering the cloud AI infrastructure market alongside AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. The move signals Meta's data center buildout has outpaced its own model training needs.
items.why: Signals AI cloud competition intensification; relevant to watchlist 谷歌 (Google Cloud), and broader AI infrastructure re-rating narrative.

items.title: 阿里巴巴与DOJ达成$6亿和解：跨境商品标签违规
items.summary: 美国司法部（DOJ）宣布，阿里巴巴集团及其子公司AUS Merchant Services同意支付6亿美元，解决涉嫌在跨境电商交易中错误标注商品原产地、规避关税及海关申报的指控。这是针对阿里跨境业务的最大单笔监管和解。
items.why: 阿里巴巴（BABA/9988.HK）重大监管事件；$6亿罚款影响利润预期，需关注后续对Temu等同类跨境平台的示范效应。

items.title: Circle CRCL -17.55%: Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, BlackRock, Coinbase launch Open USD stablecoin coalition
items.summary: Circle's stock (CRCL) plunged 17.55% after Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, BlackRock, and Coinbase jointly launched 'Open USD' — a competing stablecoin consortium designed to rival USDC. The move directly threatens Circle's core USDC franchise and market share in institutional stablecoin settlement.
items.why: Circle (CRCL) is a watchlist holding; -17.55% single-day move reflects direct competitive threat to USDC moat. Also relevant to 稳定币法案 (GENIUS Act) narrative.

items.title: Palantir +7.77%: Army NGC2 AI contract win + Nvidia Nemotron model deal
items.summary: Palantir (PLTR) surged 7.77% after announcing it won the U.S. Army's Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) AI platform contract, and separately partnered with Nvidia to deploy Nemotron language models on Palantir's Foundry/AIP platform for defense and government clients.
items.why: Palantir is a watchlist holding; government AI contract wins are the core thesis driver. NGC2 + Nvidia partnership reinforces AIP platform moat.

items.title: 小米汽车6月交付逾3万辆，H1累计约18万辆
items.summary: 小米汽车6月单月交付量超30,000辆（SU7+YU7），上半年累计交付约18万辆，同比大幅增长。YU7 SUV自5月上市以来订单持续旺盛，小米已跻身中国新势力前列，雷军宣布全年目标上调至35万辆。
items.why: 小米（1810.HK）EV业务里程碑：交付量超预期将推动估值重估，影响covered call行权价参考。

items.title: BofA泡沫风险指标达警戒线：半导体AI估值过热
items.summary: 美银美林（BofA）发布报告称，其内部"泡沫风险指标"已上升至2021年科技泡沫以来的最高水平，点名半导体/AI基础设施估值"严重透支"，建议投资者对MU、INTC、AMD、NVDA等芯片股保持谨慎，适当降低仓位比例。
items.why: 直接影响持仓：英伟达、美光、闪迪、英特尔均在观察列表。BofA警告可作为covered call或sell put行权价调整的参考依据。

items.title: BYD Q2纯电交付55.7万辆碾压特斯拉：EV竞争格局加剧
items.summary: 比亚迪公布Q2纯电动车（BEV）交付量557,000辆，同比增长约38%，远超特斯拉市场预期约406,000辆（特斯拉官方数据7月2日发布）。BYD在欧洲、东南亚市场同步扩张，全球EV竞争格局持续向中国品牌倾斜。
items.why: 特斯拉（TSLA）是观察标的，BYD交付超预期直接压制特斯拉估值溢价，影响TSLA sell put策略风险判断。

items.title: South Korea KFTC alleges Google abused Android app dominance via GVP exclusivity contracts; potential fine ~849B won (~$615M)
items.summary: Korea's Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) on July 1 formally alleged Google abused its dominant Android app market position by signing exclusivity-style GVP (Project Hug) contracts with 22 top game companies — incl. Activision Blizzard King, Riot Games — over 6.75 years to prevent them from leaving Google Play. Affected revenue ~$9.2B. Max fine could reach ~849B won (~$615M), or 6% of relevant revenue.
items.why: 谷歌(GOOGL)继欧盟DMA令后再遭韩国重磅监管指控，多国反垄断压力叠加或影响AI广告/分发生态估值，持GOOGL仓位需关注监管折价风险。

items.title: Tencent ramps up buybacks as share rout wipes out $309 billion: June repurchases top HK$9B — record monthly high for 2026
items.summary: Bloomberg reported June 30 that Tencent spent over HK$9 billion (~US$1.1B) on buybacks in June — set to be its largest monthly repurchase total in 2026 — buying back shares nearly every trading day since mid-May. Shareholders approved repurchase of up to ~912 million shares (10% of total) at May AGM. Shares have fallen ~$309B in market cap since October peak.
items.why: 腾讯大规模回购是EPS利好信号（10%股本回购授权），但$3090亿市值缩水凸显近期港股科技整体下行压力；对covered call策略需要重新评估行权价，sell put需提高审慎。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) jumps 11% July 1 as Bernstein raises target to $3,000 (+76%); NAND long-term contracts reshape supercycle thesis
items.summary: Bernstein raised SanDisk (SNDK) price target from $1,700 to $3,000 (June 30), maintaining Outperform. Thesis: structural shift to long-term NAND supply agreements (LTAs) with fixed/range-bound pricing, with ~$42B contracted through 2028. Base-case FY2027 EPS estimate $243. SNDK surged 11% on July 1, adding to its ~490% YTD gain — best performer in S&P 500 in 2026.
items.why: 闪迪(SNDK)Bernstein升目标价至$3000代表市场首次将LTA固定定价结构纳入估值，显著降低了NAND周期性下行风险；对持有SNDK或存储赛道的投资者是重要估值锚，sell put策略隐含波动率也可能因此收窄。

items.title: 欧盟7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境包裹免税，Temu欧洲本土备货仅约20%、面临成本骤升挑战
items.summary: 欧盟自2026年7月1日起正式取消150欧元以下跨境电商包裹免税政策（此前为de minimis exemption）。Temu欧洲本土备货比例仅约20%（远低于应对目标），物流模式已从空运（占比85%→2%）切换为船运以压缩关税成本至3-5%。拼多多(PDD)2025年净利润同比下降12%，Temu欧洲增速承压。
items.why: 欧盟免税取消是拼多多(PDD)面临的重大政策转折点，可能进一步压制2026年下半年Temu欧洲GMV增速；建议在业绩指引明朗前对PDD期权策略保持审慎，尤其避免短期裸卖put。

items.title: S&P 500 & Nasdaq post best quarter since 2020; Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surges 87.8% in Q2 — record quarterly advance
items.summary: The S&P 500 rose 14.8% and the Nasdaq gained 21.4% in Q2 2026, their best quarterly gains since the pandemic rally of Q2 2020. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index soared 87.8% in the quarter, its largest-ever quarterly advance, driven by the AI chip supercycle. Over 80% of S&P 500 companies beat earnings estimates in Q2, well above the long-run average of ~60%.
items.why: 美股创2020年以来最强季度，AI芯片板块领涨87.8%，港股科技股估值有望跟随修复；但季末大涨后隐含波动率可能回落，逢低布局sell put需关注7月初回调风险。

items.title: Tesla Q2 2026 delivery report due July 2: Wall Street consensus 406,024 vehicles; Goldman Sachs estimates 420,000
items.summary: Tesla is set to release Q2 2026 delivery figures on July 2. Wall Street consensus stands at 406,024 vehicles. Goldman Sachs analyst Mark Delaney estimates 420,000, citing solid recovery in Europe and China. Morgan Stanley raised its Q2 estimate to 413,000. For context, Q1 2026 left a ~50,000-unit inventory overhang. Tesla earnings follow on July 22.
items.why: 明日交付数据是TSLA近期最直接催化剂；若达420K+可触发多头追仓；持仓时可于7/22财报前布局covered call或观望sell put行权价位（TSLA当前约$370，YTD -17%）。

items.title: USTR proposes additional 12.5% Section 301 tariff on China in June; effective tariff rate on Chinese goods remains near 30%
items.summary: The US Trade Representative proposed a new 12.5% tariff on Chinese goods in June 2026 under a Section 301 forced-labor investigation. Combined with existing tariffs, the effective rate on many Chinese goods shipped to the US remains close to 30% — the highest of any trading partner. The tariffs amount to an average additional tax of $1,500 per US household in 2026.
items.why: 额外关税直接压制Temu/拼多多出海收益；港股出口相关标的估值受压；通胀预期上升使美联储降息时间后移，对全仓港股持仓产生多重负面：压制估值、抑制消费需求。

items.title: Tencent shares jumped ~10% after Bloomberg/CNBC reported WeChat AI agent 'Xiaowei' in consumer testing and enterprise 'Dayuan' rolling out on WeCom
items.summary: Tencent began testing 'Xiaowei', a native AI assistant within WeChat (consumer), allowing voice/text interaction with friends and mini-programs. The enterprise version 'Dayuan' — built on DeepSeek V4 — began rolling out on WeCom on June 23. Xiaowei uses Tencent's WeLM model, with DeepSeek for certain queries. Shares jumped most since late 2022 on the news. Public launch compliance process underway.
items.why: WeChat月活超13亿，AI原生接入若完成合规落地，将大幅提升变现潜力并催化估值重估；10%的股价反应显示市场已开始定价AI预期，腾讯(0700.HK)期权隐含波动率可能上升。
items.source: South China Morning Post / Bloomberg / CNBC

items.title: 阿里巴巴FY2026全年：云收入+34%至人民币1,581亿元，AI产品贡献云收入30%；总调整EBITA骤降56%，未来三年投入超550亿美元于AI基础设施
items.summary: 阿里云FY2026营收1,581亿元（同比+34%），调整后EBITA +35%至142.65亿元，AI相关产品贡献云收入约30%。然而集团整体调整后EBITA同比-56%至764亿元，自由现金流转为使用25.1亿美元，因大规模投入即时零售、用户获取及AI基础设施。公司宣布FY2026-FY2028间将投入逾550亿美元于AI与云数据中心。
items.why: 云+AI赛道高增长证明需求真实，但利润大幅下滑表明资本开支周期尚未进入收获期；自由现金流转负对分红/回购能力产生压制，sell put时需充分评估盈利能见度风险。

items.title: SK hynix ships HBM4E 12-layer samples (June 18): 16 Gbps/pin, 20% better power efficiency; UBS forecasts ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia Rubin
items.summary: SK hynix announced on June 18 that it has shipped HBM4E samples (12-layer) to major customers. Performance: maximum 16 Gbps per pin data speed and >20% power efficiency improvement vs HBM3E. Uses Advanced MR-MUF technology to achieve 48 GB in a 12-layer stack. UBS forecasts SK hynix will achieve ~70% HBM4 market share for Nvidia's next-generation Rubin platform. Nasdaq ADR listing (ticker SKHY) scheduled for around July 10.
items.why: HBM4E官方出货确认AI存储超级周期深化；CSOP南方两倍做多SK海力士ETF(7709.HK)直接受益；配合美光Q3+346%的营收数据，整体HBM供应商都有估值重估空间。

items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $58,000: June ETF outflows hit record $4.06B — largest monthly outflow in spot ETF history
items.summary: Bitcoin fell ~2% to ~$58,690 on July 1 as quarter-end pressure combined with record spot ETF outflows. US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $4.06 billion in net outflows in June, the largest monthly outflow since the products launched. K33 notes 5-day net ETF flows were -34,267 BTC, the second-largest such stretch on record. Analysts warn no clear bottom yet confirmed.
items.why: 加密市场持续走弱是风险偏好收缩信号；Circle(CRCL)稳定币叙事赖以支撑的加密热度正在降温，同时BTC ETF流出规模创纪录也提示宏观避险情绪升温。

items.title: 美团发布万亿参数大模型LongCat-2.0：1.6万亿参数，业界首个全程国产算力（5万卡集群）完成训练
items.summary: 美团于6月30日开源LongCat-2.0，总参数1.6万亿（MoE架构，平均激活约48B），预训练数据逾30万亿token，原生支持100万token超长上下文；全程由国产AI芯片（5万卡集群）训练——中国大模型国产算力自主化里程碑。在OpenRouter实时调用量全球前三，专为Agentic Coding任务优化。
items.why: 美团(3690.HK)AI自研能力突破标志其摆脱Nvidia GPU依赖，可能大幅降低长期推理成本；开源策略也有助于扩大生态影响力，是Tech持仓中的估值催化剂。

items.title: 携程集团Q1 2026净收入162亿元(同比+17%)；国际OTA平台预订量+65%，入境游预订量+90%
items.summary: 携程2026年Q1净收入162亿元（同比+17%），调整后EBITDA约48亿元（+14%）。分项：住宿预订收入65亿元(+17%)，交通票务61亿元(+12%)，旅游度假11亿元(+19%)，商旅管理6.9亿元(+20%)。国际业务爆发：境外OTA平台预订量同比+65%，入境旅游预订量激增+90%，来自亚太、欧洲、美国多个主要客源市场。
items.why: 出境和入境游双双超预期，提升携程全年盈利能见度；然而H1股价已跌逾30%（HSI最差成份股之一），sell put时行权价需与当前股价保持充足安全边距（30%+缓冲）。
items.source: 新浪财经 / 携程集团

items.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 delivers early economic boost: host city card spending +6.3% YoY; $9B GDP impact expected across North America
items.summary: Early July data shows card-based purchases in the 16 World Cup host cities up 6.3% year-over-year, driven by a 16.7% surge from non-local visitors. The tournament (June–July 2026, North America) is expected to generate ~USD 9 billion in GDP, drawing 6.5 million attendees including 2.6 million international visitors. Beneficiary sectors: hospitality, dining, sports betting, and media (Fox Corp holds English-language rights to all 104 matches).
items.why: 世界杯消费热潮对多项持仓形成催化：泡泡玛特FIFA联名Labubu出圈（品牌破圈）、美团Keeta在中东市场扩张获间接助力、麦当劳/好市多受益于美国消费提升；期权方向看，消费股implied vol或已提前定价。

items.title: EU orders Google to open Gemini AI and Android features to rivals under DMA; Alphabet simultaneously rationing Gemini access due to compute constraints
items.summary: The European Commission issued instructions to Alphabet requiring that competing AI developers can access core Google services linked to Gemini and Android under the Digital Markets Act (DMA). Simultaneously, Alphabet is limiting Gemini AI access as cloud capacity tightens, suggesting demand is outstripping supply. Alphabet's Gemini app has surpassed 750 million monthly active users. Alphabet also announced an $80B equity offering to fund AI compute infrastructure.
items.why: EU监管压力可能削弱谷歌在欧洲的AI生态护城河；Gemini算力限流反映AI基础设施扩张压力；$800亿融资规模创科技史上最大股权融资之一，短期摊薄效应值得关注（GOOGL期权波动率可能上升）。

items.title: SanDisk (SNDK) leads S&P 500 in 2026 with YTD gains reportedly exceeding 800%; NAND supply shortage confirmed to extend past 2027
items.summary: SanDisk (SNDK), spun off from Western Digital in February 2025, is the best-performing S&P 500 stock in 2026 with year-to-date gains of ~800–900% reported by multiple analyst sources. Catalysts: global NAND flash shortage, surging AI data center demand. The company says 2026 production capacity is fully sold out, with 2027 bookings described as strong. Q3 reported revenue of $5.95B with non-GAAP gross margins of 78.4%.
items.why: SNDK的爆涨幅度与美光Q3数据共同印证了NAND供应紧缺真实且持续，支撑美光/SanDisk期权策略：存储类股波动率高，sell covered call获取权利金具有吸引力；同时说明AI存储超级周期尚在进行中。

items.title: Palantir wins $300M USDA Blanket Purchase Agreement; 2026 revenue guidance $7.2B (+61% YoY); government AI contract awards expected to accelerate Q3
items.summary: Palantir secured a $300 million Blanket Purchase Agreement with the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) to support the National Farm Security Action Plan. The company provided 2026 revenue guidance of $7.2 billion, implying ~61% growth. In Q1 2026, AIP secured 204 contracts over $1 million, including 53 exceeding $10 million. Government contract awards typically accelerate in Q3 (July–September) as agencies complete budget allocation.
items.why: 政府合同加速落地提升PLTR营收能见度；但估值已极度拉伸（P/S >30x），持仓时需警惕任何预期差；高隐含波动率使sell put策略的权利金回报率较高，但需设置较宽安全垫。

items.title: （存疑）拼多多/Temu三重利空：欧盟5月罚款2亿欧元+美国日活骤降+营收增速降至个位数；PDD股价从峰值跌逾30%
items.summary: 欧盟于2026年5月对Temu开出2亿欧元罚款，指控其允许销售在欧盟境内非法产品。同年1月，都柏林总部遭突击检查，土耳其分支亦被突击。美国取消800美元以下包裹免税政策后，Temu被迫转向半托管模式，丧失低价优势，美国日活用户大幅下滑。PDD Holdings营收增速从2024年的59%降至个位数，股价自2025年11月峰值下跌逾30%。
items.why: Temu出海变现逻辑持续受损；若持有PDD多头仓位，需重新评估成长故事是否已破坏；拼多多目前估值已明显调整，sell put时行权价需结合营收减速风险充分下调。

items.title: Half-year Hong Kong stocks report: HSI drops 11%, Hang Seng Tech falls 19% — among worst globally; Trip.com -30%+ worst in index
items.summary: The Hang Seng Index declined 11% in H1 2026 while the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 19%, ranking Hong Kong among the worst-performing major markets globally. Key culprits: the Fed's hawkish pivot (from rate-cut mode to rate-hold/hike discussion) which compressed HK equity multiples, and the Hang Seng's lack of pure-play AI infrastructure names comparable to Nvidia. Trip.com plunged over 30%, making it the worst-performing constituent.
items.why: 港股整体板块承压直接冲击腾讯、阿里、美团、小米、携程等全部港股持仓；美联储鹰派转向是根源，若7月加息落地将进一步压制估值；sell put时须将行权价设定在充足安全垫以下，避免高贝塔港股持仓在宏观逆风中被逼仓。

items.title: Dow closes above 52,000 for the first time as Alphabet joins index on debut day (+4.8%), replacing Verizon; marks best quarter for S&P 500/Nasdaq in six years
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at a record 52,182.74 on June 29, 2026 — crossing 52,000 for the first time — boosted by Alphabet's debut day gain of ~4.8% as it replaced Verizon after 22 years. Alphabet is now the fifth Magnificent Seven mega-cap in the Dow (joining Nvidia, Amazon, Apple, Microsoft). Three tailwinds converged: Alphabet's index debut, a Supreme Court ruling protecting Fed independence, and easing US-Iran tensions. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq wrapped up their best quarter since 2020.
items.why: 谷歌（持仓标的）加入道指触发大量被动资金买入、首日大涨近5%，标普与纳指最强季度印证美股科技强势；道指创新高对持仓美股科技标的（英伟达、Palantir、特斯拉等）的市场情绪有正向溢出效应，隐含波动率短期有所压缩。

items.title: SpaceX to join Nasdaq-100 on July 7 under fast-track framework — record fastest inclusion; JPMorgan estimates $4.3B in forced ETF buying
items.summary: SpaceX (SPCX) will officially join the Nasdaq-100 Index before trading begins on July 7, 2026, just 15 trading days after its June 12 IPO — setting a record as the fastest Nasdaq-100 inclusion in history under the exchange's new fast-track framework. J.P. Morgan estimates approximately $4.3 billion in forced buying from QQQ and other index-tracking products as sponsors rebalance. Over $800 billion tracks the Nasdaq-100.
items.why: 43亿美元被动资金流入将在7月6日收盘后开始买入SpaceX，纳指成份整体被动需求上升，利好持仓中追踪纳指标的（Palantir、英伟达、谷歌等）的流动性环境；同时科技指数权重集中度进一步上升，整体beta加大。

items.title: South Korea announces $518 billion semiconductor mega-plan: Samsung and SK Hynix each build two new fabs; HBM packaging plants in Chungcheong
items.summary: On June 29, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, Samsung Chairman Lee Jae-yong, and SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won jointly announced an 800 trillion won (~$518 billion) national semiconductor ecosystem project. Samsung and SK Hynix will each construct two new fabrication plants in South Korea's southwest near Gwangju. Samsung will additionally build HBM packaging facilities in the Chungcheong region to meet soaring AI demand. S&P said the accelerated Yongin investment is well within both companies' financial flexibility.
items.why: SK Hynix（持仓核心）国家级产能背书是最强政策红利：HBM长期供应保障、政府补贴降低资本成本；短期重大利好推高存储半导体板块情绪（美光、闪迪也受益）；但10年维度产能大幅扩张意味着未来HBM价格压力，sell put时须动态审视行权价。

items.title: （存疑·待核）美联储6月连续第四次维持利率3.50%-3.75%，但5月PCE通胀再度走高；高盛认为7月加息概率约50%
items.summary: 美联储在新任主席沃什主持的6月FOMC会议上全票通过维持基准利率3.50%-3.75%不变——连续第四次暂停。然而5月PCE物价指数同比涨幅创2023年10月以来新高，核心PCE持续高于2%目标。据报道高盛认为7月加息概率约50%，点阵图显示近半数委员支持年内加息。具体PCE数字待BEA一级公告核对。
items.why: 加息预期升温是港股H1最差表现的根源，若7月真加息将进一步压制小米、腾讯等高成长港股估值；美国核心通胀再抬头对全部权益资产均形成再定价压力；sell put策略须确保行权价低于当前支撑区、并在财报季前控制总敞口。

items.title: SK Hynix plans Nasdaq ADR listing as early as July 10, targeting ~$29.65 billion; funds for HBM fab expansion and ASML EUV acquisition
items.summary: SK Hynix, the world's second-largest memory chipmaker and dominant HBM supplier (~60% market share), confirmed plans to list American Depositary Receipts on Nasdaq as early as July 10, 2026, targeting 17.79 million new shares and proceeds of ~45.5 trillion KRW (~$29.65 billion). Underwriters: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan. Proceeds earmarked for new fab construction in South Korea and acquisition of ASML extreme ultraviolet scanners.
items.why: SK Hynix美股ADR上市将吸引大量美国机构投资者、大幅提升国际可见度，间接利好南方两倍做多SK海力士(7709.HK)等港股工具的估值重估；融资29.65亿用于HBM产能，长期保障英伟达Rubin平台供应链安全；本周有7/10上市事件驱动。

items.title: Micron Q3 FY2026: revenue $41.46B (+346% YoY), EPS $25.11 — both records; 16 take-or-pay deals lock $100B minimum revenue; HBM4 in HVM for Nvidia Rubin
items.summary: Micron reported fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $41.46 billion (+346% YoY, beat by ~$6B vs. consensus), non-GAAP EPS $25.11 (beat $20.28 est.), adjusted operating margin 81.2%. Most structurally significant: 16 strategic take-or-pay customer agreements lock in approximately $100 billion in minimum contracted revenue and $22 billion in upfront cash — a structural break from the industry's historic boom-bust cycle. HBM4 entered high-volume production for Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform; HBM products remain fully booked through at least 2027.
items.why: 美光（持仓标的）财报大幅超预期，1000亿合同锁定收入大幅降低周期波动风险，为sell put提供强力基本面锚定；HBM4与Rubin绑定是长期价值护城河；闪迪(SNDK)和SK海力士同属存储赛道，受整体叙事支撑。隐含波动率财报后可能回落，sell put时机窗口。

items.title: Tesla FSD V14 Lite rolls out to Hardware 3 owners, stock surges >8% in best single day in over a year; Q2 deliveries seen below consensus at ~393K; earnings July 22
items.summary: Tesla shares surged over 8% to close at $411.84 — their best single-day performance in more than a year — driven by the rollout of Full Self-Driving V14 Lite to early-access Hardware 3 owners. On the delivery front, Baird projects Q2 deliveries of ~392,900 units, below street consensus, though Cantor sees Q2 energy storage beating at 15.7 GWh vs. 13.9 GWh consensus. Tesla is scheduled to report Q2 earnings on July 22, 2026 after market close. Cantor calls 2026 a 'transformational year' for Tesla's shift into autonomy, robotics and chips.
items.why: 特斯拉（持仓标的）FSD V14推出是自动驾驶商业化里程碑，可能触发新一轮估值重估；8%单日涨幅显著抬升隐含波动率，对已有sell put的持仓须审查行权价安全边际；7/22财报是Q2关键催化剂，交付低预期与储能超预期将形成复杂叙事，建议在财报前适当管理期权敞口。

items.title: 港交所6月30日发布咨询总结：优化港股每手买卖单位框架，7月2日起第一阶段实施、11月16日全面推行
items.summary: 香港交易所6月30日发布咨询总结，宣布优化港股每手买卖单位框架：降低每手价值指引下限、增设上限，并标准化每手股数。分两阶段：第一阶段7月2日起，潜在和现有上市发行人须遵守新指引；第二阶段11月16日起，所有发行人采用标准化股数。此外，6月29日恒生指数收跌1.8%（405点）至22,672，受全球AI/半导体股抛售拖累。
items.why: 每手单位优化将降低散户买入门槛、改善港股流动性，对高价成份股（腾讯、老铺黄金等）的换手率有正面影响；恒指周跌1.8%印证上半年弱势延续，持仓估值仍承压。

items.title: 腾讯6月30日回购120万股、耗资约5.006亿港元（均价约417港元/股）；下次业绩披露预计8月19日
items.summary: 根据港交所披露易（Next Day Disclosure Return）文件，腾讯控股（0700.HK）于6月30日在场内回购并注销约120万股股份，耗资约5.006亿港元，均价约417港元/股。腾讯年内持续推进大规模股份回购计划，不断缩减流通股本。下次季度业绩披露预计为2026年8月19日。
items.why: 持续且大额的回购是腾讯最明确的内在价值认可信号，直接支撑股价下限；对sell put策略，公司在约417港元附近主动回购意味着其自身锚定的安全价格，行权价可考虑设在此区间附近；下次财报8/19前仍有约七周窗口期。

items.title: Intel 18A-P node enters initial production; preliminary Apple foundry deal reported; Alphabet and Nvidia also evaluating Intel as chip manufacturer; INTC +169% YTD
items.summary: Intel announced its 18A-P process node — an advanced performance variant of 18A — has entered initial production. WSJ/CNBC reported a preliminary agreement with Apple for Intel Foundry Services to manufacture some Apple Silicon chips (initial shipments not until Q2/Q3 2027). Reports of Google and Nvidia evaluating Intel as backup AI chip manufacturer triggered additional stock gains. Intel shares are up approximately 169% year-to-date, with the foundry turnaround thesis gaining broad validation from Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft orders.
items.why: 英特尔（持仓标的）同时获得苹果、谷歌、英伟达三大科技巨头验证是代工转型叙事的历史性拐点，是近十年最强基本面改善信号；但Apple首批芯片出货在2027年，短期财务贡献有限；当前股价已在169% YTD涨幅高位，sell put时须注意预期充分定价后的回调风险。

items.title: （存疑·待核）阿里巴巴成立新AI部门Token Foundry整合核心研发；承诺未来三年投入3800亿人民币于AI与云基础设施
items.summary: 阿里巴巴成立新AI部门Token Foundry，将通义千问实验室（Tongyi Lab）与Future Life Lab合并整合，由CEO吴泳铭（Eddie Wu）领导统一AI研发战略。公司承诺未来三年内投入约3800亿人民币（约560亿美元）于AI与云基础设施，目标五年内将云+AI年收入做到1000亿美元。云智能集团AI相关产品营收已连续十个季度实现三位数增长。Token Foundry细节待公司官方披露核实。
items.why: 阿里（BABA/9988.HK持仓标的）3800亿人民币AI押注是明确战略转向，云AI十连季三位数增长是估值支柱；若Token Foundry整合顺利，将强化通义千问在大模型赛道竞争力；对sell put策略，BABA基本面改善降低了深度行权的尾部风险，可适度提高行权价。

items.title: 泡泡玛特Labubu亮相2026 FIFA世界杯开幕式——中国原创IP首次登上世界杯舞台；THE MONSTERS×FIFA联名系列全球40+国同步首日售罄
items.summary: 6月12日，泡泡玛特旗下角色Labubu作为特邀嘉宾亮相2026年FIFA世界杯开幕式（墨西哥城），这是中国原创IP历史上首次参与FIFA世界杯开幕式。同期，THE MONSTERS × FIFA World Cup联名系列（含盲盒、周边）在超过40个国家和地区同步开售，线上库存首日告罄。此前（5月），Labubu已出现在FIFA世界杯官方主题曲MV中，为首个进入FIFA官方音乐视频的设计师玩具品牌。
items.why: 泡泡玛特（9992.HK持仓标的）世界杯开幕式曝光是Labubu品牌国际化里程碑——全球200+国受众、与FIFA顶级IP绑定，将显著提升欧美市场品牌溢价与复购率；首日售罄印证需求强劲，支撑高估值持续性；sell put行权价可保持在相对高位，关注后续销售数据确认。

items.title: Fed proposes new stablecoin oversight rules targeting Circle (CRCL); USDC market cap $78B; Circle H1 2026 revenue $1.25B, 95.5% from interest income
items.summary: The Federal Reserve proposed new oversight regulations for payment stablecoin issuers, directly targeting Circle Internet Group and its USDC token — following the landmark GENIUS Act which established mandatory reserve backing, federal licensing, and auditing standards. USDC now commands a $78 billion market cap. Circle reported H1 2026 revenue of $1.25 billion, with 95.5% derived from interest on short-term Treasury-backed reserves. Company market cap is ~$29.5 billion. BlackRock manages Circle's reserves; BNY Mellon handles custody.
items.why: Circle/CRCL（持仓标的）面临美联储新监管是双刃剑：监管明确长期利好机构采用USDC，但短期合规成本上升；H1营收12.5亿、95.5%来自国债利息意味若7月美联储加息，Circle财务直接受益；从期权策略角度，监管不确定性维持高隐含波动率，适合宽跨度sell put策略。

items.title: Nvidia Vera Rubin enters full production (GTC Taipei); RTX Spark AI PC chip launches Fall 2026 with Dell, HP, Microsoft, ASUS
items.summary: At GTC Taipei (June 1, 2026), Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang confirmed Vera Rubin — the successor to Blackwell Ultra — has entered full production with partner delivery beginning H2 2026, delivering 10x lower inference token cost vs. Blackwell. Separately, Nvidia unveiled the RTX Spark superchip (Grace CPU + Blackwell GPU, 128GB unified memory) at Computex 2026, launching in Windows AI PCs from Dell, HP, Microsoft, ASUS, Lenovo, and MSI in Fall 2026. Rubin roadmap: Rubin Ultra → Feynman (2027-28) → Rosa Feynman (2029-30).
items.why: 英伟达（持仓标的）Rubin进入全面生产代表Blackwell周期已达顶峰、新周期开启；Micron HBM4进入高量产正是为Rubin配套；RTX Spark开辟AI PC全新营收赛道；多产品线并行落地显著增强英伟达的长期收入可见性，支撑sell put行权价在相对高位。

items.title: （参考）黄金现货价格在4000美元/盎司附近整理；摩根大通预测年底或至6000美元；老铺黄金(6181.HK)目前52周区间569–1108港元
items.summary: 黄金现货价格在2026年6月末维持每盎司约4000美元附近（近期高点约4020美元），较2025年11月低点已大幅回升。摩根大通全球研究预测金价年底或推升至6000美元/盎司，2027年有望达到6300美元。老铺黄金（6181.HK）当前在569–586港元区间交投，52周高低点为540–1108港元，距高点已较大折让。
items.why: 老铺黄金（持仓标的）直接受益于黄金牛市：摩根大通年底6000美元目标若兑现，将推动老铺产品单价与营收显著提升；当前股价距52周高点打折约50%，金价若续涨是修复契机；sell put行权价宜参照支撑区间下轨约540港元附近。

items.title: 美团Keeta Q1 2026亏损大幅收窄：从23.8亿美元降至9.6亿美元（-60%）；沙特市场接近月度盈利首次；管理层称全年新业务亏损不超上年
items.summary: 美团（3690.HK）Q1 2026财报显示，Keeta海外外卖业务亏损从2025年同期约23.8亿美元大幅收窄至9.6亿美元（同比改善约60%）。管理层在财报会上表示，沙特阿拉伯市场在月度层面已接近首次实现盈利，继香港（2025年10月实现盈利）后成为第二个接近盈亏平衡的海外市场。公司预计2026年全年新业务板块亏损总额不超过上年水平。
items.why: 美团（持仓标的）Keeta亏损快速收窄是出海盈利时间轴明确化的关键信号；若沙特实现盈利将成为估值重估催化剂；对sell put策略，海外业务进入兑现期降低了尾部风险，可适度调高美团期权行权价；关注Q2财报（Keeta香港、沙特是否持续盈利）。
